scope: Independent read-only review of Native A snapshot before preload B edits. No compilation, application/QQ execution, Git mutation or profile/cache access. Existing decoder test executable used only with synthetic loopback WAV.

observed: All FFmpeg operations use the composed Impl callback, preserving the external AutoMix cancellation callback and the existing atomic cancellation owner.
Startup uses one 15-second deadline across open and probe; HTTP read deadline uses observed AVIO bytes_read progress; seek uses a 5-second phase deadline.
Non-EOF av_read_frame errors and stored AVIO errors latch a failure instead of starting successful EOF drain.
Pipeline reports generic read/decode/processing errors and lets existing valid ring contents drain only when control/render are Playing and no render error is latched.
Promotion and consumeEnded remain blocked for processingFailed sources.
specCompliance.gap: Cancellation latched into readFailure is not reset by restartPcmStreamTransform; the advertised after-join restart contract needs a dedicated blocking HTTP cancel/restart test and fix or narrower explicit contract.

findings.title: Clear or explicitly reject cancellation-latched read failure during after-join restart
trace: cancelPcmStreamTransform sets transformCancelled while an HTTP av_read_frame is outstanding.
decodeOneFrameImpl handles cancellation through ioError(&readFailure, read), storing decode_cancelled.
restartPcmStreamTransform clears transformCancelled but leaves readFailure untouched.
The next decodeOneFrameImpl immediately returns the old cancellation failure before attempting input, despite restart returning true.
findings.impactBoundary: Static direct API-contract counterexample, not a reproduced user playback bug. Pipeline stop discards active streams and pause does not stop decoding, so normal pause/device changes are not proven affected. Actual recovery must also consider whether FFmpeg retains AVIO error after cancellation; do not silently clear genuine network_io_timeout/read failures.
findings.verificationGap: Original A executable lacked a restart mode; implementation owner subsequently added a real HTTP cancel/join/restart case.
findings.closure: Decoder e91accf1fa9e7befb3427bace06ceab0980aad2f8b13d9f3f09619bddd26cddb records readFailureWasCancelled and only clears cancellation-classified sticky/AVIO state on after-join restart. Independent resume-read check passes: cancelledBeforeRestart and restarted true, 1536000 frames after restart, error false, true EOF, no parent kill. Receipt qq-task14-native-a-restart-independent.json. This restart does not promise frame-exact continuation; the synthetic 40-second example produced 1916928 rather than 1920000 frames, consistent with the documented need to reposition for exact continuation.

raceAndLifetimeReview.boundary: Phase/deadline/bytes_read are used on the FFmpeg IO owner thread; cross-thread stop uses an atomic. open/seek/reset require transport ownership and prior reader join, so arbitrary concurrent open/seek are not a supported counterexample.
raceAndLifetimeReview.autoMix: Bounded AutoMix decoder's external cancellation token remains in the synchronous job lifetime. Continuation clears setInterrupt(nullptr, nullptr) before starting its live decode thread. New composed callback consults current Impl callback fields instead of retaining an old copy in AVFormatContext. No new dangling callback was found.

results: Complete WAV decodes 1920000 frames with true EOF and no error.
HTTP declared full Content-Length but early clean close returns error with eof false, preserving 384000 decoded frames.

Chunked response ending cleanly after eight seconds can still report true EOF despite a longer WAV data header. This has no HTTP transport error; it is an explicit content-integrity boundary, not proof of a regression in ret!=EOF handling. QQ proxy's strict range/length validation is still required.

limits: Interrupt deadlines are cooperative FFmpeg IO budgets, not OS-hard wall-clock cancellation of arbitrary codec, filesystem, DNS or external library work.
Read budget resets on transport bytes, not PCM production; continuously arriving non-audio traffic can keep it alive by design.
No measured claim about real QQ music, P2P or the historical playback timeout follows from these synthetic checks.
